tells.1: Bolded inline lead-ins on every bullet and goal, introduced by the stock line 'The consequences are significant:'
tells.3: Bolded inline lead-ins on every bullet and goal, a templated list structure
tells.4: Minor 'X, not Y' contrast ('only for exceptions, not routine reassignments'), otherwise none

reason: Version 4 keeps the scannable bullet structure a PRD needs but drops the bold lead-ins. Its phrasing is plainer and more direct ('Agencies pay for it', 'Show coordinators what the system did'), so it reads like a practiced PM. Version 2 is similarly clean, but folding the impacts into one dense paragraph makes them harder to scan.
